generalInfo: This game takes place in the Japanese Miraku High School. The player is the new transfer student and in the same class as Miko, Cari, Eve, and Lia. Lena is a class ahead and the head of the student council; they represent students interests. The following places can be visited: classroom, coffee shop, clubroom, hallway, rooftop, and music room. The school is small, so it has no gym or cafeteria, but it has a small coffee shop where snacks, lunch, and, of course, coffee can be bought. It happens to be an all-girls school. It has a few school clubs that happen in the afternoon after class; those include the music club, the art club, the technology club, and the gymnastics club. Miko is part of the music club, Lia is part of the technology club, and Cari is part of the gymnastics club. Any PE activity is happening in a second location's gym. General thought subjects are math, Japanese, English, and physics. Some electives include chemistry, biology, history, economics, informatics, and philosophy. Some impressions about the teachers are the following: the history teacher = pretty obsessed with history, the English teacher = traveled abroad for years, informatics teacher = easygoing, the math and Japanese teachers = old school, physics teacher = a bit unorganized. There are no cases of bullying, but Cari is known for being mean to anyone outside of her clique. Eve is known as a troublemaker but harmless if left alone. Eve is also the 1-year-older sister of the player. The atmosphere in the school is relaxed, almost a bit boring. The school is located in a small town, not a village or metropolis.
